short: RAVEn's asymmetric momentum-teacher objective (M03) ties AV-HuBERT at Large with 30 h (32.5%); its lead comes with self-training (M02), whose pseudo-label decoding is not stated.
position: The paper [@haliassos2023raven] changes the pre-training objective (M03), asymmetric cross-modal prediction of momentum-teacher latents, and training-only audio supervision (M02); both stay standard. At Large, 1,759 h unlabelled and 30 h labelled without self-training or LM, its 32.5% VSR WER equals AV-HuBERT's 32.5% [@shi2022avhubert], so the lead rests on Base models, 27.8% against 28.6% at 433 h, and self-training, without repeat runs. Along the same audio pseudo-labelling route on the same data RAVEn gains 7.7 points and AV-HuBERT 3.9, and RAVEn's pseudo-label decoding is not stated. The abstract compares with 25.9% from 90,000 hours while its own Table 1 lists 19.3%.
